messages:
maria_sales: Passing NovaThrive (mid-market fintech) to CS. Signed yesterday. Key asks: Okta SSO, VPC peering in eu-west-1, dedicated throughput around 2k reqs/min, and EU data residency. Renewal risk ~30% if onboarding slips.

liam_cs: Thanks Maria. Priya will lead onboarding. Priya, can you confirm SSO plan and provisioning ETA? @devon we might need eng help for VPC peering and perf tuning.

priya_cs: Acknowledged. I'll run the kickoff and gather metadata. Maria, please drop SP/IDP metadata and the customer's network CIDR here. Also need primary customer contact.

maria_sales: Adding contact: sara@novathrive.com. Staging Okta metadata: https://okta.example/metadata/sara. Customer CIDR: 10.8.0.0/16. CSM kickoff booked for 2026-03-25 10:00 PT.

ben_support: Noted. I'll open INC-5492 for Dedicated infra config + expected traffic. Assigning to infra queue and will attach token/throughput numbers. @devon pls validate assumptions.

devon_eng: I'll run perf sims. For 2k reqs/min with median ~120 tokens and ~10% long reads to 800 tokens, recommend pre-warm KV cache and validate batching profiles. Priya, can you share expected prompt mix and percent of long reads so I can simulate realistic loads?

priya_cs: Prompt mix: conversational 60%, structured gen 30%, long-document extraction 10%. Median ~120 tokens, long reads ~800 tokens. Sharing sample prompt set + warmup script in a gist — will paste here when ready.

maria_sales: One more note: Legal requested a SOC2 addendum review. Sheila is looped and this could add a 1-2 week hold depending on findings.

liam_cs: Owners + immediate next steps: Priya = onboarding lead; Ben = infra ticket & capacity estimate; Devon = perf simulations; Maria = customer contact; Sheila = legal review. Action items: 1) Priya to collect full Okta metadata + CIDR confirmation (EOD), 2) Ben to create INC-5492 and attach expected tokens/tps (EOD), 3) Devon to run perf sim and post results (48h), 4) Sheila to start SOC2 addendum review and flag blockers. I'll create a dedicated channel for post-kickoff ops. Risk callout: if SSO not completed within 10 days, renewal risk increases. :warning: 

onboard-bot: Reminder — kickoff calendar event for 2026-03-25 10:00 PT created and invites sent.

priya_cs: Gist + warmup script (will attach to INC-5492). Sample warmup snippet:

```bash
# warmup loop to populate KV cache
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/v1/generate \
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
    -d '{"prompt": "<sample_prompt>", "max_tokens": 150}' >/dev/null &
done
```

priya_cs: I'll update INC-5492 with the gist, warmup script, and prompt set. Planning an internal sync after kickoff to confirm timeline. :thumbsup:
